record.file_problem: The README is cut at 60,000 characters; the remaining text is unavailable.
record.tranche_reason: The repository analyzes Reaper's provenance and benchmarks its outputs, but does not test or rely on the single refusal-direction claim or any listed version.
record.gate_note: The README's report that model cards claim 0/465 refusals is attributed to those cards, not presented as a result of this study. Its code comparisons describe tool implementation, not outcomes of applying or removing the claimed direction. The benchmark statement about capability changes is a result for abliteration outputs generally, but the text does not attribute it to single-direction ablation.
record.test_reason: This is a forensic provenance and licensing analysis of the reaper-abliteration tool against Heretic. It reports KL divergence and an unquantified statement of capability change for abliterated models. It never measures refusal rates produced by its own runs, and never tests whether a difference-in-means direction mediates refusal. The 0/465 refusal figure is quoted from HauhauCS's model cards, not measured. No version is tested.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly correct. The authors conclude that reaper-abliteration is a Heretic fork, plagiarized and relicensed in violation of the AGPL. They find HauhauCS's models come from Heretic's pipeline plus known third-party techniques, with no novel method. They report that their KL and benchmark results contradict the claims of ~10% of Heretic's KL and zero capability loss.
record.recipe_differences: The repository compares Reaper's code with Heretic and describes Reaper as Heretic-derived, but does not test the original refusal-direction recipe.

fits_no_version.finding: HauhauCS-edited models showed higher KL divergence from the base model than Heretic-edited ones on two of five models (Qwen3.5-9B: 0.32 vs 0.0825; Qwen3.5-27B: 0.256 vs 0.063), and lower KL on the other three.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The distributional cost (KL) of abliteration varies widely by toolchain, technique combination and model size.

fits_no_version.finding: Capability changes were measured on all tested abliterated models over 8 lm-eval tasks, but no magnitudes are given.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Abliteration outputs from this toolchain show capability changes on the study's benchmark suite.

record.problems: The README gives no task-level capability scores or magnitude for the reported changes and does not attribute them to a specific editing method. It notes that KL measurements vary with hardware and CUDA version, but does not provide uncertainty for the capability result.
record.rows_left_out: No rows for the listed KL comparisons: they measure KL divergence, not refusal behavior or a listed version's named outcome. The model-card refusal figures are reported as claims from the cards, not as results produced by this study.

untested.parts: All parts: the direction, its ablation or addition, refusal rates, and capability preservation attributable to the direction.
Whether weight-edited released models stop refusing. No refusal rate is measured; only refusal claims quoted from model cards appear.
All parts. The study mentions Reaper's rank-k ablation and LEACE but reports no comparison of their refusal effects.

record.verdict_notes: The weight-level cosine similarity results (median 0.966 with the published Heretic edit) concern provenance, not any version, and are rightly not rows. The README is truncated, but the visible sections contain no refusal-rate measurements.

rows.subject: HauhauCS models (all tested models)
rows.operation_detail: Ran standardized lm-eval-harness benchmarks on abliteration model variants.
rows.value: The study reports measurable capability changes across all tested models; task-level values and the magnitude of changes are not stated.
rows.note: This is a result for abliteration outputs generally. The README does not attribute the changes to the claimed difference-in-means direction or give enough detail to assess whether capabilities were largely preserved.
rows.check: The row gives no task-level values, magnitudes or baseline, so the value can't be read. It is a capability measure on edited models with no refusal rate. It compares two abliteration toolchains, not the direction claim, so it bears on no version.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
